prompts.greeting: Namaste. Yeh aapke lender ki taraf se aapke loan ke baare mein ek zaroori call hai.
prompts.menu: Agar aap EMI pehle hi bhar chuke hain, 1 dabaiye. Agar aapko thoda aur samay chahiye, 2 dabaiye. Hamare pratinidhi se baat karne ke liye 3 dabaiye. Menu dobara sunne ke liye 9 dabaiye.
prompts.invalid: Maaf kijiye, yeh vikalp sahi nahi hai.
prompts.ack_paid: Dhanyavaad. Hum aapka bhugtan verify karke WhatsApp par update denge.
prompts.ack_time: Dhanyavaad. Hum aapko WhatsApp par bhugtan ki tareekh ke liye sampark karenge.
prompts.ack_callback: Dhanyavaad. Hamare pratinidhi aapko jald call karenge.
prompts.goodbye_unresolved: Hum aapse baad mein sampark karenge. Dhanyavaad.

rules: Never speak amounts or loan numbers (no verification on IVR)

body.custom_ref: Kairos touch_id passed when the call is placed

callback.idempotency: one outcome per call_id; repeated completions are ignored
